opencode-go.doc: Go: server rolling 5h AND weekly AND monthly (API status rate-limited or percent>=90) are real caps — weekly 100% 402s even when 5h is ok. Local $12/5h $30/wk $60/mo is a rough $ mapping. Quota is not a model failure; never unfavorite.

cursor.doc: Cursor: local-db estimate against the $20 subscription baseline; provider endpoint is optional.

grok-sub.doc: SuperGrok: local-db estimate against the $30 subscription baseline (not xAI metered); provider endpoint is optional.

openai.doc: OpenAI/ChatGPT: exact percentages and reset times come from GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage using OAuth plus ChatGPT-Account-Id. No local dollar baseline is valid.

claude-code.doc: Claude Code CLI subscription: local bridge is configured, but no provider quota endpoint is exposed here.

grok-build.doc: Grok Build CLI subscription: local harness bridge is configured; quota is provider-owned and not exposed by the bridge.

codex.doc: Codex CLI subscription: local harness bridge is configured; quota is provider-owned and not exposed by the bridge.

openrouter.doc: OpenRouter API: metered provider; this view shows local usage only and does not infer a subscription percentage.
